title: Rotator Cuff Repair (Open or Arthroscopic)
description: Medicare coverage guidelines for rotator cuff repair. Requires MRI confirming full-thickness tendon tear (or high-grade partial tear > 50%), persistent pain/weakness, and failure of at least 3 months of conservative care (or acute traumatic tear in active patient).

criteria.name: Full-Thickness or High-Grade Rotator Cuff Tear on MRI
criteria.description: Diagnostic MRI or ultrasound confirming full-thickness supraspinatus/infraspinatus tear or high-grade partial thickness tear > 50% depth.
entity_names: high-grade rotator cuff tear on mri
keywords: high-grade rotator cuff tear on mri
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Conservative Therapy Trial Failure (>= 3 Months)
criteria.description: Trial and failure of >= 3 months (90 days) of conservative treatment (physical therapy, NSAIDs, subacromial corticosteroid injection) unless acute traumatic tear.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Severe Irreversible Muscle Fatty Infiltration (Goutallier Grade 4)
criteria.description: Chronic massive irreparable tear with severe muscle atrophy and Goutallier Grade 4 fatty degeneration precluding structural healing.
criteria.clinical_intent: Disqualify irreparable fatty degeneration for primary repair
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD. Previously cited L34246 was Routine Foot Care. Covered under orthopedic surgical benefit.
